entries.prompt:
Generate ONE isolated rigid horned metal mask from the actual NECA Ultimate Elder/Greyback2022edition, using ONLY THE MASKED-HEAD ACCESSORY AT THE UPPER RIGHT of the FIRST official white-background catalogue photograph. Preserve that accessory mask's near-front photographed camera, slight inclination, exact broad/short proportions and paint. The SECOND official staged photograph corroborates the same horned shell, not a different view to combine. This belongs to the Golden Angel horned sculpt family, but is specifically the documented2022Elder edition; no claim of new geometry or an actual masked Greyback film appearance. Do not use the bare-headed main figure, the separate human skulls, the body, or a smooth Golden Angel mask.

Keep the whole actual rigid bronze/olive-gold shell with dark rubbed weathering: broad angular forehead, the existing short paired swept horn-like tips at upper sides, source layered side/ridge panels, the pronounced central dark/bronze forehead relief, strong slanted red/orange opaque eye lenses, narrow bridge, rounded upper-cheek bulges and dark pitted side vents, and the single long rounded central gold snout plate with its two dark narrow side channels and lower small real metallic fittings. Preserve the actual photographed horn arrangement, edges, seam design, eye colour, dark paint and scuffs; add no extra horns, vents, glyphs, glowing emitters, teeth, hoses or biomechanical pieces. Only what is visible in these photographs.

Remove ALL black dreadlocks and their bands, living skin/cranium/neck, collar/armor, shoulder cannon, weapons, the accessory hand, skulls, figure body and entire catalogue/scene background. Keep only the rigid mask, not a severed head. Do not convert the red solid eye lenses into transparent holes, do not expose biological mouth or teeth. No invented hidden back/interior geometry, no forced symmetrization/frontalization or rotation from its source camera. For A preserve the even soft catalogue lighting, restrained weathered olive-bronze/gold with dark black/grey paint, no dramatic coloured scene light or chrome mirror finish.

One full mask on genuine transparent alpha, no text/grid, no support/floor/cast-shadow plane. Request1254x1254square if supported. Object78–80percent of the largest canvas axis,8–12percent clear margins all sides, including tips and lower fittings, no clipped tips. This is a licensed photographed toy-edition study; fine weathering and microdetail cannot be certified1:1beyond the source pixels.
